name: Immich
description: Self-hosted photo and video management with mobile backup, albums, search and sharing.
differentiator: Offers a self-hosted alternative for managing personal photo and video libraries.
limitations: Self-hosting requires maintenance and backups; the project specifically warns about robust backups.
Product features are confirmed by its repository; general market demand is not established.
This is an established product, not a launch from 2026-11-03.

en.who: Imagine years of family photos spread across devices and cloud services.
en.pain: You want search, sharing and backups, but also control over storage.
en.solution: Immich offers a photo library you can run on your own server.
en.benefit: It may give technically comfortable households more control.
en.uncertainty: Are maintenance and backup responsibilities worth the trade-off?

zh.who: 想象手机和电脑里有很多年的照片，既想随时搜索和分享，又想自己掌握数据。
zh.pain: 方便的云服务和自己控制照片存储之间，往往需要取舍。
zh.solution: Immich 提供可以部署在自己服务器上的照片管理、备份与搜索体验。
zh.benefit: 对愿意自己维护服务的人来说，可能更有掌控感。
zh.uncertainty: 维护成本和可靠备份是否会让普通用户望而却步？

fr.who: Imaginez des années de photos réparties entre appareils et services cloud.
fr.pain: Vous souhaitez sauvegarder et partager sans perdre la maîtrise du stockage.
fr.solution: Immich propose une photothèque hébergée sur votre propre serveur.
fr.benefit: Cela pourrait offrir davantage de contrôle.
fr.uncertainty: La maintenance et les sauvegardes compensent-elles cet avantage ?
